id: \rIt's good to raise your team equally.
en: \rIt's good to raise your team equally.
it: \rÈ bene allenare la squadra in modo equilibrato.

id: \bYou ever think of going to school? Haha like you would ever give up what works for something so slow paced and boring.
en: \bYou ever think of going to school? Haha like you would ever give up what works for something so slow paced and boring.
it: \bHai mai pensato di andare a scuola? Ahah, come se tu potessi mai rinunciare a qualcosa che funziona per una cosa così lenta e noiosa.

id: \bWe were raising your Pokémon, and my goodness, were we surprised!
en: \bWe were raising your Pokémon, and my goodness, were we surprised!
it: \bStavamo allevando il tuo Pokémon e, santo cielo, che sorpresa!
\bIl tuo Pokémon aveva con sé un Uovo!

id: \bWe don't know how it got there, but your Pokémon had it.
en: \bWe don't know how it got there, but your Pokémon had it.
it: \bNon sappiamo come ci sia finito, ma ce l'aveva il tuo Pokémon.

id: \bYou have no room for it right now... Come back when you've made room.
en: \bYou have no room for it right now... Come back when you've made room.
it: \bAl momento non hai spazio... Torna quando ne avrai fatto.

id: \me[Egg get]\PN received the Egg from the Day-Care Man.
en: \me[Egg get]\PN received the Egg from the Day-Care Man.
it: \me[Egg get]\PN ha ricevuto l'Uovo dal signore della Pensione.

id: \bI really will keep it. You do want this Egg, yes?
en: \bI really will keep it. You do want this Egg, yes?
it: \bAllora lo tengo davvero. Lo vuoi questo Uovo, sì?

id: \bWell all right then, I'll take it. Thank you.
en: \bWell all right then, I'll take it. Thank you.
it: \bVa bene, allora lo prendo io. Grazie.

id: \bThat is, I don't think we'll ever find another...
en: \bThat is, I don't think we'll ever find another...
it: \bCioè, non credo che ne troveremo mai un altro...

id: \bNo, no, I'm sure we'll find another one. I'm definitely sure of it!
en: \bNo, no, I'm sure we'll find another one. I'm definitely sure of it!
it: \bNo, no, sono sicuro che ne troveremo un altro. Ne sono assolutamente certo!

id: \bI help take care of the precious Pokémon of trainers.
en: \bI help take care of the precious Pokémon of trainers.
it: \bAiuto ad accudire i preziosi Pokémon degli Allenatori.

id: \bAny Pokémon you'd like to have raised you can leave in my wife's care.
en: \bAny Pokémon you'd like to have raised you can leave in my wife's care.
it: \bSe vuoi far allevare un Pokémon, puoi lasciarlo alle cure di mia moglie.

id: \bThe two play with other Pokémon rather than with each other...
en: \bThe two play with other Pokémon rather than with each other...
it: \bQuei due preferiscono giocare con altri Pokémon piuttosto che tra loro...

id: \bThe two don't seem to like each other much.
en: \bThe two don't seem to like each other much.

id: \bThe two seem to get along very well.
en: \bThe two seem to get along very well.

it: \bSto marinando la scuola. Non dirlo a nessuno.

id: \bDon't make me go back to school.
en: \bDon't make me go back to school.

id: \rHead south of here and you will see a day care.
en: \rHead south of here and you will see a day care.
it: \rVai a sud di qui e vedrai una Pensione.

id: \rI help out at the day care.
en: \rI help out at the day care.

id: \rBe sure to stop at the day care.
en: \rBe sure to stop at the day care.

id: \rHe's not actually my boyfriend yet. Don't tell him.
en: \rHe's not actually my boyfriend yet. Don't tell him.
it: \rIn realtà non è ancora il mio ragazzo. Non dirglielo.

id: \rYou'll need at least two Pokémon if you want to battle us.
en: \rYou'll need at least two Pokémon if you want to battle us.
it: \rTi servono almeno due Pokémon se vuoi sfidarci.

id: \rBianca: Let's battle. Wait, let me find my Poké Ball.
en: \rBianca: Let's battle. Wait, let me find my Poké Ball.
it: \rBelle: Lottiamo. Aspetta, devo trovare la mia Poké Ball.

id: \rBianca: That was fun. Let's do it again real soon.
en: \rBianca: That was fun. Let's do it again real soon.

id: \bTrip: You again? Do you really think you can beat me? You're a worthless bumpkin from Kanto.
en: \bTrip: You again? Do you really think you can beat me? You're a worthless bumpkin from Kanto.
it: \bTrip: Ancora tu? Credi davvero di potermi battere? Sei un buzzurro di Kanto buono a nulla.

id: \bTrip: As I expected, there wasn't much to learn from you. I'd hurry back home while you still can.
en: \bTrip: As I expected, there wasn't much to learn from you. I'd hurry back home while you still can.
it: \bTrip: Come immaginavo, non c'era molto da imparare da te. Fossi in te tornerei a casa finché sei in tempo.

id: \bTrip: I got a few pictures, but it still only shows how little you know.
en: \bTrip: I got a few pictures, but it still only shows how little you know.
it: \bTrip: Ho fatto qualche foto, ma dimostrano solo quanto poco sai.
\rHo catturato i miei Pokémon con Kumi.
